| Campaign | Kingmaker (PF2e), with Starfinder 2e classes |

## Description

Red hair, green eyes and a burgundy suit.

## Assets

Metadata for every file is in `character.yaml`.

- `fortune-keyart.webp`: master art
- `fortune-portrait.webp`: 1:1 portrait
- `fortune-token`: animated token (casino chip ring) as `.webm` (use in Foundry, it shows animated WebP as a still frame), `.webp`, and `.gif` (under 8 MB, for Discord); `fortune-token.png` is the static version
